description: Per-country measurement DEPTH: how many distinct ISP networks (ASNs) Voidly has evidence from — a proxy for how many independent vantage points back a country's data, which bounds what the >=3-network confirmed-block gate can confirm. Read current coverage from the response. HONEST: coverage depth is NOT a censorship score; an absent/shallow country is under-measured, not free. Pass country=XX for one country.

country.description: Optional ISO country code, e.g. RU, IR

name: get_network_depth
